# nie

> *Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road*, in the browser. The game's own screens, its own text, its own
> files — served from the paths the game itself uses. Nothing is renamed and nothing is
> transcoded ahead of time: an address here is an address inside the game.

Three languages share one origin, told apart by a URL segment: French at the root, English under
`/en/`, Japanese under `/ja/`. The three declare each other with `hreflang`; what lies behind
them is the same content.

If you are an agent, prefer the JSON API below over the HTML pages. It is paginated, stable, and
returns the same identifiers the game uses.

## Sections (HTML)

- [Textures]({{ origine }}/textures): every texture, at its original path, converted on demand.
- [Models]({{ origine }}/modeles): assembled and exportable models.
- [Sounds]({{ origine }}/sons): audio banks (ACB, AWB, HCA), decoded on demand.
- [Videos]({{ origine }}/videos): in-game videos (USM).
- [Browse]({{ origine }}/explorateur): walk the directory tree instead of filtering by kind.
- [Settings]({{ origine }}/settings): language, theme, list density, text size — the game's Options screen.

## JSON API

- [Health]({{ origine }}/api/v1/health): what this instance can currently answer.
- [Characters]({{ origine }}/api/v1/chara): names in French, English and Japanese.
- [A catalogue]({{ origine }}/api/v1/textures): also `modeles`, `sons`, `videos`.
- [Episodes]({{ origine }}/api/v1/episodes): the animated series catalogue.

Pagination is `?page=` and `?per_page=` on every list; `per_page` defaults to 50 and is capped
at 200. Responses carry a total, so a crawl is bounded before it starts.

## Files

- `{{ origine }}/f/<path>` — one file, at its exact in-game path, extension preserved.
- `{{ origine }}/b/<prefix>` — list one directory of the game's file tree.

They are deliberately excluded from `robots.txt` and from the sitemap: crawling them one by one
is the wrong shape for this data. Use `/b/` to walk the tree, or the catalogue API to select
first.

## Optional

- [Full reference]({{ origine }}/llms-full.txt): URL conventions, formats, limits, examples.
- [Sitemap]({{ origine }}/sitemap.xml): every page, in all three languages.
